continuation.summary: The existing classifier accepts any supported input type (text, email, tel, url) for every recognized contact field, allowing incompatible controls to become verified_candidate. The autonomous regression file is missing. Earlier implementation attempts incorrectly interpreted the immutable test's Git blob SHA-1 identity as a raw file digest, causing implementation-stage failure. The corrected script uses Git blob hashing, restricts edits to the two approved paths, and adds isolated public-fixture regression coverage.: The immutable test retains Git blob SHA-1 identity 8b4d37223ee08c0add0d5b349875a8e8983cd0d9. Only the two authorized files change. Incompatible contact controls require human_review; compatible native and generic text controls preserve existing behavior. Unknown, ambiguous, unsupported, and unverified fields remain protected. The autonomous regression file exists and all ten mandatory test cases pass independently before commit. The worker verifies the resulting commit and receipts. No network, private data, application submissions, deployment, publication, or automatic merge.
